Calendar schema descriptions cover local preference, global prohibition, CLI override, and matching rule.

Invalid config tests assert failures happen before Calendar or Telemost client initialization.

CHANGELOG.md and README.md mention the change.
Targeted pytest, full pytest, and regression pass.
Schema test validates config.agent.example.json against config.agent.schema.json.
